name: Coven’s Curse (Coven)
body:
Your coven can place terrible and devastating curses on those who’ve wronged them.

Prerequisite(s): Coven Casting, caster level 7th, coven member.

Benefit(s): When a member of your coven casts a curse spell while receiving bonuses from Coven Casting, also apply that bonus to the spell’s save DC.
